label: ETV6::RET

sections.text: ETV6 encodes an ETS-family transcriptional repressor with an amino-terminal oligomerization domain.
RET encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase activated by GDNF-family ligands and their coreceptors.
The fusion couples the ETV6 oligomerization region to the RET kinase domain. It is an alternative driver in salivary secretory carcinoma, a tumor more commonly associated with ETV6::NTRK3.

For RET-fusion-positive locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors, selpercatinib is US-approved from age 2 years after prior systemic treatment or when no satisfactory alternative exists; this is a RET biomarker-class indication.
